description: Fetch an X account: username, name, description, location, the link in the profile, verified, created_at, and public_metrics (followers_count, following_count, tweet_count and more) — named as in X's own API v2. Use this to size an account or enrich a handle. Give exactly one of `username` or `url`. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

url.description: The profile URL, on x.com or twitter.com.

username.description: The username. A leading @ is fine.

name: get_x_profile
title: Get an X profile
